# AWL - Deploy Firebase Functions

## Purpose

Deploy Firebase Cloud Functions.

---

## Features

- Validate firebase.json
- Install Dependencies
- Build Functions
- Deploy All Functions
- Deploy Selected Function
- GitHub Step Summary

---

## Inputs

| Input | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| project-id | Firebase Project |
| firebase-token | Firebase Token |
| functions-target | Optional Function Name |

---

## Used By

- awl-deploy-firebase-functions.yml

---

## Prerequisites

- Firebase CLI
- Node.js
- firebase.json
- functions folder
